rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that has sand on or in it.

example.english: I don't want to wear sandy shoes into the house.
example.traditional: 我唔想着對有沙嘅鞋入屋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoek3 deoi3 jau5 saa1 ge3 haai4 jap6 uk1

rows.note: Use this when the surface or object is completely covered in sand.

example.jyutping: seng4 go3 saa1 taan1 dou1 hai6 saa1

rows.note: Use this for a sandy or gritty texture, especially when something feels grainy in the mouth or under touch.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lei4 sik6 lok6 saa1 saa1 dei6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the pale beige-brown colour associated with sand.

example.english: I want to buy trousers in a sandy colour.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 saa1 sik1 go2 tiu4 fu3
